units.source_text: 然而，我的脑子却在这黑暗中越来越清楚了，

en.t: However, my mind was becoming clearer and clearer in the darkness,

units.source_text: 我又在半无意识的状态下，对K‘喂’了一声，

en.t: and again, in a half-unconscious state, I called out to K, "Hey,"

units.source_text: K也像刚才一样‘唉’了一声。

en.t: and K answered, "Yes," just as he had before.

units.source_text: 我终于主动说出，很想跟他好好谈谈今天早上他对我说的事情，问他现在行不行，

en.t: At last I brought it up myself, saying that I wanted to talk properly with him about what he had told me that morning, and asked whether now would do,

units.source_text: 当然我也不愿意隔着隔扇跟他谈这件事，

en.t: of course, I did not want to discuss the matter with him through the sliding partition,

units.source_text: 不过至少可以得到K的回答，

en.t: but at least I could get K's answer,

units.source_text: 可是K这次没有应声，不像刚才我叫他两次，他两次都很快答应了那样，

en.t: but this time K did not respond as readily as he had when I called him twice before and he answered promptly both times,

units.source_text: 只是含糊地小声说‘是啊’。

en.t: he only murmured vaguely in a low voice, "Yes."
